name: Gabapentin
description: Gabapentin (Neurontin) facts: uses for shingles pain and seizures, off-label uses, dosing basics, breathing warnings, misuse, state scheduling, withdrawal, and legal access.
quick: Gabapentin (Neurontin) is one of the most prescribed medicines in the US, approved for shingles nerve pain, partial seizures, and (as Horizant) restless legs syndrome. It is not a federal controlled substance, but several states classify it as Schedule V because it is misused, especially with opioids.
facts: Prescription only; not federally controlled; Schedule V in several states
Postherpetic neuralgia; partial-onset seizures (add-on); restless legs (Horizant)
Capsules, tablets, oral solution, extended-release tablets
Hours to days for pain relief
Breathing problems with opioids or sedatives

blocks.p: Gabapentin is approved for postherpetic neuralgia (nerve pain after shingles) in adults and as an add-on treatment for partial-onset seizures in people 3 and older. Gabapentin enacarbil (Horizant) is approved for restless legs syndrome and postherpetic neuralgia.[[1]]
It is also widely prescribed off-label for other nerve pain, alcohol use disorder, anxiety, hot flashes, and insomnia, with varying evidence.

The figures below come from the FDA-approved label and describe how prescribers typically use gabapentin. They are not personal dosing advice. A prescriber sets the dose for each person and adjusts it over time.[[1]]

blocks.p: Gabapentin absorption is saturable: higher single doses are absorbed less efficiently, so it is taken in divided doses.

sections.q: What are the risks and side effects of gabapentin?

blocks.p: **Common side effects** include dizziness, drowsiness, unsteadiness, fatigue, swelling of the legs, and blurred vision.[[1]]

**Serious risks** include breathing problems with opioids or in lung disease, allergic reactions (DRESS), suicidal thoughts (antiseizure class warning), and misuse, mainly by people who also use opioids.[[1]]

blocks.warn: The FDA warns that gabapentin and pregabalin can cause serious, sometimes fatal, breathing problems when combined with opioids or other sedatives, and in older adults and people with lung disease.[[2]]

sections.q: What does gabapentin overdose look like?

blocks.p: Gabapentin overdose causes double vision, slurred speech, drowsiness, lethargy, and diarrhea. Serious overdoses usually involve opioids or other sedatives, which can stop breathing.[[1]][[2]]

emergency.title: If someone may have overdosed
items: Call 911 if the person is unresponsive, hard to wake, or breathing slowly.
For advice when the person is awake and stable, call Poison Help at 1-800-222-1222 (US, free, 24 hours).
If opioids could be involved, including pills not from a pharmacy, give naloxone if you have it. Naloxone does not reverse gabapentin, but it will not harm the person.
Stay with the person and place them on their side if they are drowsy or vomiting.

sections.q: What is gabapentin withdrawal like, and how long does it last?

blocks.p: Stopping gabapentin after regular use can cause withdrawal. The label advises tapering over at least one week.[[1]]

timeline.title: Peak
timeline.text: Agitation, confusion, and in people with epilepsy, seizures.

blocks.warn: In people with epilepsy, stopping gabapentin suddenly can trigger seizures, including prolonged seizures.

sections.q: How do you get gabapentin legally in the US?

blocks.p: In the United States, gabapentin is a prescription-only medicine. It is not a federal controlled substance, so the only legal way to get it is with a prescription from a licensed clinician, filled by a licensed pharmacy.

ul: **Refills:** refills follow ordinary prescription rules, but some states treat it as a controlled substance with tighter limits.

**Pharmacies:** a legitimate pharmacy always requires a valid prescription, has a licensed pharmacist available, and is licensed in the state it ships to. The FDA's BeSafeRx tool and the NABP's safe pharmacy list help confirm a pharmacy is real.[[3]][[4]]
**Cost:** generic gabapentin is among the least expensive prescription medicines.

**State rules:** several states, including Alabama, Kentucky, Michigan, Tennessee, Virginia, and West Virginia, list gabapentin as a Schedule V controlled substance, and many others require pharmacies to report it to the state prescription monitoring program.

blocks.p: **Traveling:** keep the medicine in its original pharmacy container and carry a copy of the prescription. Check the rules of the destination country before travel, because many countries restrict controlled medicines or require a permit.

Yes, but only with a valid prescription and only from a pharmacy licensed in your state. Many licensed pharmacies, including mail-order pharmacies run by insurers, fill gabapentin prescriptions online and ship them. Buying gabapentin from a website that does not require a prescription is illegal, and the product is often fake.[[3]][[5]]

steps: A clinician evaluates you in person or by telemedicine and decides whether gabapentin is appropriate.
The prescription goes to a pharmacy
Prescriptions for controlled medicines are usually sent electronically, straight from the prescriber to the pharmacy you choose.
The pharmacy checks and fills it
A pharmacist verifies the prescription and your identity, then dispenses the medicine in person or by mail.

blocks.p: **Signs that an online seller is illegal:**

ul: It sells gabapentin with no prescription, or after only a short online questionnaire.
It takes orders through social media, messaging apps, or email.
It asks for payment in cryptocurrency, gift cards, or money transfers.
It has no US street address, no state pharmacy license, and no pharmacist to speak to.
Its prices are far below those of ordinary pharmacies, or it ships from another country.

blocks.p: The FDA's BeSafeRx tool links to each state's license lookup, and the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy lists verified online pharmacies.[[3]][[4]]

sections.q: Is gabapentin legal in other countries?

blocks.p: Laws change and differ in detail. Check current rules before carrying any controlled medicine across a border.[[6]]

faq: Not federally. Several states classify it as Schedule V, and many track it in their prescription monitoring programs.
No. It is not an opioid, but it can be misused and adds to opioid overdose risk.
Can gabapentin help with anxiety or sleep?
It is sometimes used off-label for these, but evidence is limited and it is not FDA-approved for them.
How long does gabapentin stay in your system?
Its half-life is 5 to 7 hours in healthy kidneys, so it is mostly gone within 2 days.
